requirements: Verify branch and PR heads, source ancestry, assignment, ownership and released diagnostic before claiming. Use clean isolated checkout and free fixed ports; use bounded host wrapper, heartbeat and cleanup checks.

Negative proof is a synthetic shell-only mutation: retain exact-head test and JVM marker scaffold but replace only solr/bin/solr with contributor version. After both roles are ready, the focused ordering assertion must fail because the ZooKeeper host was stopped first. Startup, compilation, readiness, timeout or skipped tests do not satisfy it. Retain logs and XML.

Restore exact head and run both packaging variants, tidy and root check with normal security manager. Require order assertion, no force kill, and both processes stopped. Capture fresh logs and XML, exits and skips. Tidy must leave tree unchanged; repairs require a new pushed head and superseding gate.

An existing unrelated timeout-utility test skips because it invokes timeout without operands; disclose any skip. The role helper has connect and total curl timeouts. An overall host watchdog remains required.

The test masks the enable flag from classification while using real nodes. It does not prove every real alternative configuration or macOS. Diagnostic probe at prior head passed once per CLI after temporary readiness waits; do not substitute it for these exact-head results.
Ref-guide/Antora exclusions follow the standing board rule. No source authoring or public comments are assigned.
